title: Mexican Guanciale Tacos
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Mexico with these oven-baked tacos featuring crispy guanciale and fresh cilantro.
instructions: Wrap corn tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 20-30 seconds.
In a large pan, cook the diced guanciale over medium heat until crispy.
Add diced roasted sweet potatoes to the pan and cook until heated through.
Season with cumin and black pepper.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning the guanciale and sweet potato mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve with sour cream and shredded cheese on the side (if using).
Garnish with additional cilantro and a sprinkle of queso fresco (if desired).
